· Significantly above SMA100 ($1,981.18) and SMA200 ($2,062.97): maintaining long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (29.9%): high relative to historical lows, low relative to historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (57.8→57.2): continued sideways movement in the neutral zone, confirming lack of directional conviction.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-21.1567→-18.0001): improving within negative territory, no confirmation of bearish reversal signal yet.
· Bollinger Band position (Middle Band $2,472.64): consolidating around the middle band, with a band width of 5.91% indicating moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($2,443.96): close to SMA20 and Pivot S1 ($2,334.27), acting as short-term support.
· Swing Resistance ($2,520.41): close to SMA5 and Upper Bollinger Band ($2,545.71), acting as short-term resistance.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Sideways): 5-day H/L $2,663.05/$2,435.29, 20-day H/L $2,663.05/$2,356.19: no clear trend reversal signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.04x): normal level, indicating moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): lack of clear direction, continued sideways movement around SMA20, potential for trend change upon breaking upper or lower bounds.
